description: Sync GoPro videos with telemetry and render customizable overlay widgets
name: custom-overlay

scripts.build: npm run build -w @custom-overlay/core && npm run build -w @custom-overlay/cli && npm run build -w @custom-overlay/desktop && npm run build -w @custom-overlay/pwa
scripts.build:pwa: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @custom-overlay/pwa
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:locales && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @custom-overlay/desktop
scripts.dev:pwa: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @custom-overlay/pwa
scripts.sonar:scan: npm run test:coverage && docker compose --profile scan run --rm sonar-scanner
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:core && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
